verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's built-in AI can take on delegated work. Agentic mode lets models independently explore and follow links, and the Computer agent can split work across parallel sub-agents with tool access, under per-chat approval modes. Users can also supervise a coding agent's edits and approve or deny each step. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation; several of these capabilities are documented under the 'Computer' ecosystem component rather than the core chat app.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: By enabling Native Function Calling (Agentic Mode), you allow quality models to independently explore the web, verify facts, and follow links autonomously.
The AI can delegate work to parallel sub-agents with the delegate_task tool. Each sub-agent is a full chat with tool access
auto is the everyday setting: the AI can explore freely, but nothing changes on disk and no command runs until you say so.
You see the full history: every file it read, every edit it made, and the pending approval that's blocking it, rendered as tool cards with Allow / Deny buttons.
